slides.heading: Combining Numbers and Variables
slides.body: Combining Numbers and Variables is part of Mathematical and String Operations. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Combining Numbers and Variables
slides.body: Variables can hold numbers and be used in calculations. This makes formulas easier to read and change.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Using variables in formulas is like writing a price tag and quantity on a receipt before calculating the total.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Python follows operator rules exactly. Use variables and parentheses to make calculations readable and predictable.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
